title: Measure idleCompaction for long lead sessions
body: Pilot t-hj92cp6 (.krn/runs/lead/t3-ab/report.md): T3 Code is not cheaper than native Claude Code, so port nothing by migration. Remaining native lever: idleCompaction is false in ~/.claude/settings.json:74. Measure one long lead session with idleCompaction on vs off (cache-write tokens after idle gaps over the cache TTL) and enable it in .claude/settings.json if it cuts cache writes.
